privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1: Açaíwave+ respects your privacy. We are an online catalog created only for informational purposes, displaying public data about movies and series. We do not host videos, do not stream content and do not charge any fees.
privacy.section1-text: We collect only the minimum necessary for operation:

section1-list.item2: Basic browsing data (cookies and anonymous metrics);
section1-list.item3: Information voluntarily submitted, such as user registration.

privacy.section2-text: Açaíwave+ may display embedded videos from external platforms like YouTube or similar services. These videos are not hosted by us — all playback happens directly on the source platform. Any data collection during playback is the responsibility of the platform providing the video.
privacy.section3-text: We use data only to improve the experience, adjust preferences and keep the platform running smoothly.
privacy.section4-text: We do not sell data. Only analytics services may have limited anonymized access to understand platform usage.
privacy.section5-text: We take measures to keep your data protected, within the limits of a personal project with no commercial intent.
privacy.section6-text: You can request access, modification or deletion of registration data.

terms.title: Açaíwave+ Terms of Use
terms.p1: These terms explain how Açaíwave+ should be used. By continuing to browse, you agree to these conditions.
terms.section1-text: Açaíwave+ is an informational catalog created as a personal project. We are not a streaming service, we do not host videos and we do not provide copyrighted content.
terms.section2-text: The displayed information is obtained from public databases, such as TMDb. All rights belong to the original owners.
terms.section3-text: Embedded videos shown on Açaíwave+ (trailers, previews, promotional materials, etc.) are played directly from external platforms. Açaíwave+ does not control ads, cookies or recommendations shown by those platforms.
terms.section4-text: Use of the platform is completely free. There are no paid plans, subscriptions or charges.

section5-list.item3: attempting to modify or damage the site.

terms.section6-text: Açaíwave+ is not responsible for external services such as TMDb or YouTube.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.p1: This policy explains how Açaíwave+ uses cookies to improve navigation and remember basic preferences.
cookies.section1-text: Cookies are small files used to improve the user experience.

section2-list.item3: To collect simple and anonymous metrics;
